transcript: Menopause is not the end of you, and no one telling you that is the real tragedy. If you are a woman moving through this season, give me one minute. You needed these words long ago. The world taught you menopause is an ending. The end of your youth, the end of your beauty, the end of being a woman who matters. That is a lie, and it has stolen peace from millions of women who deserved better. This is not your body breaking down. It is your body closing a long sacred chapter and softly opening the next. So hear me, my friend. You are allowed to be tired. You are allowed to slow down. You are allowed to say no without explaining it. You are allowed to grieve the woman you were and still welcome the one you are becoming, the heat that rises for no reason. The night's sleep will not come, the tears that arrive without warning. None of it means you are weak. It means you are changing, and change has never been gentle. The real pain of these years is not your body. It is being made to feel invisible. It is a world that whispers you are fading, when the truth is you are being refined. You are not disappearing. You are becoming a woman with nothing left to prove. And if the days feel heavy, reach for support. You were never meant to carry this season in silence. Comment seen if you needed this today. Follow for words that walk with you and send this to a woman you love.
